messages:
Nora P.: dropping a new mock for an 'Invoke Explorer'—goal is tight run history + inline schema edit. focus: keyboard-first, compact scanning, accessible diffs. feedback?
Ethan V.: looks promising. question: how do we handle very long param blobs in the list view?
Ravi S.: collapse long JSON to a single-line preview with a 'Show details' control. expand should lazy-load the pretty JSON.
Maya H.: accessibility: the expand control needs an aria-expanded state and an accessible label that includes the run id.
Leah T.: microcopy: 'Show details' beats 'Expand JSON' for clarity with screen readers.
Nora P.: good call. also renaming 'Edit function' -> 'Edit tool definition' across the panel to match console terms.
Ethan V.: keyboard nav: Up/Down to move runs, Right to expand, Left to collapse. Enter opens editor. Does that conflict with other global shortcuts?
Ravi S.: We'll scope the keybindings to when focus is inside the run list region. Use role="region" with an accessible name.
Maya H.: popovers (diffs, tool preview) must trap focus and restore it on close. Escape should close. VoiceOver-specific note: on open move focus to the first interactive element.
Leah T.: copy tweak: change 'Copy call' to 'Copy invocation' and tooltip 'Copy full request payload' on hover.
Nora P.: can we show a small diff pill when a tool def changed between runs? clicking it opens a compact diff.
Ethan V.: yes, diff pill with a summary e.g., "schema changed" and a popover listing +/- fields. Make it keyboard-focusable.
Ravi S.: implementation: diff popovers are lightweight, not full editors. For edits, open inline editor as a sliding panel. Editor should support Ctrl/Cmd+S to save draft.
Maya H.: add aria-live="polite" announcements for save confirmation and for copying. toasts should be accessible.
Leah T.: performance: virtualize the run list for large histories. hydrate editors only when opened. cache parsed schemas.
Nora P.: UX note: primary action (Re-run) visible, others in overflow menu. mobile: collapse to single kebab menu per run.
Ethan V.: overflow must be keyboard navigable and expose role menuitem attributes.
Ravi S.: small sample payload for devs to test inline edits: 
```json
{
  "name": "get_orders",
  "description": "Fetch user orders",
  "params": [
    {"name": "user_id", "type": "string", "required": true},
    {"name": "limit", "type": "integer", "required": false}
  ]
}
```
Maya H.: test cases to add: screenreader walkthrough of list, open diff, open editor, save draft, publish. record VoiceOver session.
Leah T.: add undo for drafts (per-run undo stack) so accidental edits don't leak. Save should write to workspace draft until 'Publish'.
Nora P.: action items: Ethan - update mock with keyboard map + aria attributes. Ravi - add virtualization + lazy hydration notes. Maya - accessibility test steps and example recordings. Leah - microcopy and tooltips. ci-bot: created ticket INVOKE-2345 with attachments and checklist: https://tickets.redwood.ai/INVOKE-2345
Ethan V.: scheduling a 20-min demo tomorrow at 10:30 to walk through keyboard flows.
Nora P.: thanks all, will iterate mock and post updates before the demo.
